description: This file defines a DownloadService class responsible for downloading files, saving text files, and managing progress within a Flutter or Dart application. It interfaces with platform-specific path providers to save files into the application's documents directory.

classes.name: DownloadService
classes.description: Singleton class providing methods to download files, retrieve the documents directory, and save text files.

methods.name: getDocumentsDir
methods.description: Returns the application documents directory path as a string.

methods.name: downloadToFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from a given URL into the app's documents directory, with optional progress callback.

methods.name: saveTextFile
methods.description: Saves a string content into a text file within the app's documents directory.
